**Assessment:** rejected.

The new post asserts "credible doubts about the integrity of the election results," a general integrity claim. The closest retrieved post is T4-004055, which alleges "VOTE FRAUD" and a "months to fix" scenario with the hashtag #ElectionFraud, sharing the theme of questioning electoral integrity but making a far more specific fraud allegation rather than a hedged claim of "credible doubts" [T4-004055](#T4-004055). T4-004672 similarly attacks electoral measurement by claiming "The polls are FAKE!" attributed to a Wikileaks leak, which targets polling rather than the vote count itself, so it overlaps only loosely [T4-004672](#T4-004672). The remaining posts do not support the integrity claim: T4-004758 frames the election as a "massive repudiation of the press" rather than a legitimacy dispute [T4-004758](#T4-004758), T4-007343 offers only a vague agreement that something "sounds nondemocratic" without stating what [T4-007343](#T4-007343), and T4-005881 expresses unspecified alarm ("This is straight-up disturbing") with no stated claim [T4-005881](#T4-005881).
